excerpt.zh: 乘客们渴望踏上坚实的土地，去探索下方的外星城市。我们已经安排了由向导带领的进城游览。
excerpt.en: The passengers are eager to set foot on solid ground and explore the alien city below. We've arranged guided excursions into the city.
